parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The text content used for retrieval.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: MergeMethod
parameters.description:
The method used to merge results from multiple knowledge bases. Default value: RRF. Valid values:
- RRF
- Weight

parameters.name: MergeMethodArgs
parameters.description: The parameters for the merge method of each SourceCollection.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: RerankFactor
parameters.description:
The reranking factor. If this parameter is not empty, the vector retrieval results are reranked. Valid values: 1 < RerankFactor <= 5.
> - Reranking is slow when document chunks are sparse.
> - The recommended reranking count (TopK × Factor, rounded up) should not exceed 50.

parameters.name: RerankModel
parameters.description: The reranking model parameters for performing an additional reranking on the overall results after multi-channel merging.

parameters.name: SourceCollection
parameters.description: The information about the multiple collections to retrieve.

sub_parameters.name: Collection
sub_parameters.description:
The document collection name.

> Created by the [CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~) operation. You can call the [ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~) operation to view existing document collections.

sub_parameters.name: Namespace
sub_parameters.description:
The namespace.

> You can create a namespace by calling the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation and view the list by calling the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation.

sub_parameters.name: NamespacePassword
sub_parameters.description:
The password for the namespace.

> This value is specified by the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation.

sub_parameters.name: QueryParams
sub_parameters.description: The filter conditions for the data to query, in SQL WHERE clause format.

parameters.name: TopK
parameters.description: The number of top results to return after multi-channel recall merging.
